newsitem.title: USA: HRE plans to reorganize into corporation.
newsitem.headline: HRE plans to reorganize into corporation.

text.p: HRE Properties said on Thursday its board of trustees approved a plan to reorganize the trust from a Massachusetts business trust into a Maryland corporation.

The plan of reorganization would be a merger of the trust into a Maryland corporation wholly owned by the trust, it said. Each outstanding common share of the trust would be converted into one common share of the corporation.

In connection with the plan, HRE Properties said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the 5.3 million corporation common shares to be issued in the merger.
HRE said the plan was subject to approval of the shareholders at the trust's 1997 annual meeting on March 12, and to the listing of the corporation shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
